intended_object: The canonical quotient map B → B / f(A) for a continuous homomorphism f : A → B of compact Hausdorff abelian groups, i.e. the cokernel projection in the category of compact Hausdorff abelian groups. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body uses `QuotientAddGroup.mk' f.hom.range`, the quotient map onto B ⧸ range f. That is the canonical projection. It is continuous by `QuotientAddGroup.continuous_mk`, and its target `quotientRange f` is B ⧸ range f with the quotient topology. The range is closed because the image of a compact space in a Hausdorff space is compact, so the quotient is again compact Hausdorff. This makes the map the cokernel projection in this category. The definition is a morphism in the library's own category `CompHausAddCommGrp`, so this specific setting is part of what it is, not a needless restriction. As far as I know, Mathlib has no bundled category of compact Hausdorff abelian groups, and so no ready-made version of this morphism.
